(a) If the airplane is of a model not previously approved with the specific ski installation, it shall satisfactorily pass a ground inspection of the installation, demonstrate satisfactory landing and taxiing characteristics, and comply with such flight tests as are found necessary to indicate that the airplanes flight characteristics are satisfactory with the skis installed.
(b) If the airplane is of a model previously approved with the specific ski installation, it need pass satisfactorily only a ground inspection of the installation.
